messages:
alex: Heads up — deploy-bot paused the prod promote. artifact-signer timed out for build abc123 (was in change window). @sara @mei

deploy-bot: Promotion paused — signer-service error: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout. artifact=sha:abc123 status=pending-signature retries=3

mei: Looking at signer logs now. Connector to KMS returning 502 intermittently. Posting excerpt:
```
2026-03-23T17:15:42Z signer: request id=rx9 timeout after 30s
kms-connector: upstream 502 Bad Gateway
```

alex: If KMS is flaky we shouldn't rotate keys now. Can we fallback to manual signing and annotate audit? @sophie

mei: Manual signing possible — queue length 6. Need an ops account to fetch artifact and run offline-sign, then upload signature to artifact-store. Requires an audit ticket.

sara: PMs prefer ship today. @pm-anya any blockers on release notes/comms for manual sign?

pm-anya: Manual sign OK as long as we record: who signed, why, key id, and a release note entry. Prefer minimize manual steps. :+1:

jordan: I can run manual sign. Steps:
```
1) fetch: gsutil cp gs://redwood-artifacts/prod/abc123.tar.gz ./
2) verify checksum: sha256sum abc123.tar.gz
3) gpg --default-key operations@redwood -b --output abc123.sig abc123.tar.gz
4) gsutil cp abc123.sig gs://redwood-artifacts/prod/signatures/
5) update promotion: /bin/deploy-manual-promote --artifact abc123 --signature abc123.sig
```
I'll include ticket #1234 in the commit message.

sophie: security OK for manual sign for this change window with ops audit ticket #1234 and key id OPS-2021. Keep KMS incident separate.

ops-bot: Maintenance window reserved 11:00-12:00 PT for manual promote. Locking auto-promote until 12:00.

alex: Thanks. Jordan please proceed and ping here once done. I'll update release notes with the audit entry and note the workaround.

deploy-bot: Manual promote executed by jordan at 1745679018. Result: SUCCESS. promoted artifact sha:abc123 to prod. signature=abc123.sig (ops key OPS-2021)

sara: Great — closing the window. I'll draft release note mentioning manual-sign workaround and link ticket #1234. :tada:
